error_message: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer is mandatory and was not detected.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(a) requires the name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer to be declared on every pre-packaged commodity.
source_reference: G.S.R. 202(E) as amended up to G.S.R. 629(E), Ministry of Consumer Affairs

error_message: Common or generic name of the commodity is missing from the package label.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(b) mandates that the common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared.

error_message: Net quantity declaration is mandatory and was not detected on the package.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(c) requires the net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight, measure, or number to be declared.

error_message: Net quantity must be declared using standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L, count, N).
explanation: Rule 6(1)(c) and the First Schedule require standard legal units of mass, volume, or number.
source_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) & First Schedule - Legal Metrology Rules, 2011

error_message: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import is required.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(d) mandates declaration of the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.

error_message: Manufacturing/Packing date cannot be in the future beyond standard packing allowance.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(d) requires accurate historical or current month/year of manufacture.

error_message: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration is mandatory on retail packages.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(e) requires retail sale price to be indicated clearly on the package as 'MRP Rs./₹ XX.XX (Incl. of all taxes)'. Detection below 85% OCR confidence is flagged as CANNOT VERIFY.

error_message: MRP must explicitly indicate that price is 'inclusive of all taxes'. The tax-inclusion phrase must appear in or adjacent to the MRP declaration block — not elsewhere on the label.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(e) requires the price declaration to state 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes'. The system checks for this phrase strictly within the MRP block neighborhood (±3 reading-order lines from the MRP anchor) per the anti-hallucination compliance protocol.

error_message: MRP price value must be in standard decimal numeric format (e.g. 99.00 or 249.50). Non-standard formats are a labeling violation.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(e) and the Legal Metrology General Rules 2011 require the retail price to be expressed in standard decimal currency notation (₹ XX.XX). Integer-only prices are also acceptable as they resolve to XX.00.

error_message: Consumer Care contact details (helpline telephone, email, or postal address) are mandatory.
explanation: Rule 6(2) requires name, address, telephone number, or email address of the consumer care contact cell.

error_message: Batch or Lot number provides traceability and should be clearly marked.
explanation: Rule 6(1)(g) prescribes identification markings such as lot, code, or batch number.

error_message: Unit sale price (USP) should be formatted per standard metric quantity (e.g., Rs. X per g/kg/ml/L).
explanation: Rule 6(1)(k) requires unit sale price in Rupees per g/kg/ml/litre/number on retail packages.
source_reference: Rule 6(1)(k) - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (2021 Amendment)

regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
error_message: List of ingredients is mandatory for all pre-packaged food products.
explanation: FSSAI Regulation 5(1) requires complete list of ingredients in descending order of incoming weight or volume.

regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
error_message: Expiry date / Best Before date must be subsequent to or equal to the manufacturing date.
explanation: FSSAI Regulation 5(3) mandates Expiry Date / Best Before Date declaration for perishable packaged foods.

regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
error_message: FSSAI License number must be a valid 14-digit numeric identifier.
explanation: FSSAI Regulation 5(7) mandates the 14-digit FSSAI License number alongside the FSSAI logo on all food packages.

regulation: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
error_message: Allergen warning or declaration should be clearly stated when potential allergens exist.
explanation: FSSAI Regulation 5(8) requires allergen declarations for specified allergens (cereals containing gluten, crustacea, milk, nuts, etc.).
